info.title: Squill
info.description: Declarative, cross-platform, database-independent SQL deployment tool inspired by SSDT/DACPAC, targeting PostgreSQL and MariaDB/MySQL. Provides `deploy` and `script` commands for applying a DACPAC to a target database.

commands.name: deploy
commands.description: Deploy a DACPAC to a target database (PostgreSQL or MariaDB/MySQL).

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: ADO.NET connection string for the target database server. The provider (PostgreSQL or MariaDB/MySQL) is chosen from the DACPAC's recorded provider name. The target's schema is only read to diff against the DACPAC, so view-schema permission suffices.

options.name: --target-database
options.description: Name of the database to diff against. Defaults to the connection string's Database.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print the SQL that would be run without executing it against the database. [default: False]

options.name: --disallow-table-rebuild
options.description: Fail rather than rebuild a table when a change can't be applied with an in-place ALTER. Table rebuilds are allowed by default. [default: False]

options.name: --drop-objects-not-in-source
options.description: Drop standalone objects (tables, indexes, extensions) present in the target database but not in the DACPAC. Off by default. [default: False]

options.name: --allow-data-loss
options.description: Allow changes that may cause data loss (dropping a table or column, or rebuilding a table). By default the deploy is blocked on possible data loss. [default: False]

commands.name: script
commands.description: Generate a deployment script for a DACPAC against a target database, without executing it. Only reads the target's schema.

options.name: --connection-string
options.description: ADO.NET connection string for the target database server. The provider (PostgreSQL or MariaDB/MySQL) is chosen from the DACPAC's recorded provider name. The target's schema is only read to diff against the DACPAC, so view-schema permission suffices.

options.name: --target-database
options.description: Name of the database to diff against. Defaults to the connection string's Database.

options.name: --output
options.description: File to write the generated deployment script to. When omitted, the script is written to standard output.

options.name: --disallow-table-rebuild
options.description: Fail rather than rebuild a table when a change can't be applied with an in-place ALTER. Table rebuilds are allowed by default. [default: False]

options.name: --drop-objects-not-in-source
options.description: Drop standalone objects (tables, indexes, extensions) present in the target database but not in the DACPAC. Off by default. [default: False]
